title: The 8pen
summary: A demo of the 8pen, a gesture-based keyboard replacement for touchscreens that lets users enter text by moving around a circle. It is meant for phones, remotes and game controllers and mimics handwriting.
why: HN commenters who used it remember it as an unusually fast and accurate touchscreen text input method and a fascinating alternative to QWERTY.

quote.text: It was absolutely, hands down without question, the most accurate way to quickly enter text into a phone using only a screen.
